args.description: jumps up and stretches her free arm straight up above her head, the empty hand closing on nothing near the top of the picture but fully inside it, then hangs still from that raised hand with the legs dangling below, her other hand holding a staff topped by a blue crystal star with ribbons pointing down beside her legs; empty background above and around the raised hand: no log, no bar, no branch, no cliff, no rock, no wall, no platform, no ground. The whole weapon stays inside the picture. The character stays at the same place in the frame (the game moves her), always facing right, seen from the side; keep her look, proportions and colours exactly. Only the character is drawn, with what she holds: no effect, no motion streak, no speed lines, no trail behind the limbs or the weapon, no glow, no energy, no projectile, no smoke, no dust, no ground, the whole body inside the picture. Every frame shows the arms, legs and weapon clearly in a crisp pose, never blurred.
args.subject_description: a young woman with very long silver hair, a blue ribbon and violet eyes, a closed high-collared black and white top, a long black coat, loose black shorts reaching her knees over fully opaque black tights from waist to ankle, black boots, holding a staff topped by a blue crystal star with ribbons
args.initial_pose: in mid-air facing right, knees tucked, holding a staff topped by a blue crystal star with ribbons
